svg.title: Search, selection and frozen evaluation have different roles
svg.desc: No held-out observation may choose the winner inside the same evaluation study
svg.text: Search, selection and frozen evaluation have different roles
No held-out observation may choose the winner inside the same evaluation study
1. Development screen
At most 18 settings × 6 cells = 108 pairs
Scratch state; all rejected trials retained
Record compile, tune, reset and cache costs
2. Freeze one eligible candidate
Tuple, binary, policy and dispatch key
New held-out input pattern and sessions
Four protected gates before a scoped claim
3. Constructed setup horizon
Extra setup C = 1.2 seconds
Baseline 12 µs; warm 9 µs + dispatch 0.5 µs
Break-even: 480,000 useful invocations
4. Useful service and fallback
Charge first use, misses and dispatch
New valid families use qualified fallback
Retain live users until safe retirement
A warm winner can lose on short horizons; the additive model is conditional.
A failed holdout cannot be reused as fresh confirmation after retuning.
